question: Which benefit is NOT included in 'PM – Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana'?

options.text: Reduced electricity costs for the government
Reduced electricity costs for the private sector

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Reduced electricity costs for the private sector**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **PM – Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana** is primarily aimed at providing **free electricity to households**, promoting **renewable energy adoption**, and reducing the **electricity costs for the government.**
 
• It is a government initiative designed to enhance the use of **solar energy** in households and support the vision of a more sustainable future.
 
• This scheme emphasizes the use of **solar panels** to generate electricity, reducing dependency on conventional energy sources.
 
• While the program benefits households and the government, it does not specifically aim to reduce electricity costs for the **private sector**.
 
• The focus is largely on the **citizens and public sector**, making electricity affordable and accessible for common people.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India targets to achieve 500 GW of non-fossil fuel-based energy capacity by 2030, with solar energy playing a crucial role.
 
• Initiatives like the PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana have boosted the growth of solar capacity, particularly in the rooftop segment.
 
• The increase in solar energy capacity is supported by substantial investments and policy reforms aimed at enhancing the clean energy infrastructure.
 
• Solar energy's significant capacity underlines its pivotal role in India's renewable energy portfolio and its contribution to meeting global clean energy commitments​
